The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the supervised setting, semantic features extracted from SLRs are complementary to local context information and, in general, the best results are obtained when both types of features are used.

the use of SLRs in modern supervised WSD models can be effective, and that it is possible to design models that exploit SLR information in a way that is complementary to context based information, and to combine the two sources in a multi layer architecture.
